headline: TXT top Circle album chart with 'PERFECT STORM'
sub: 1.46 million copies in week one, plus a download chart No. 1

points.title: Also on the chart
items: 'Angel Bite' debuts at No. 11 on Global K-pop
ATEEZ lead retail album chart 2 weeks running

source: Source: Circle Chart, via Korean media
caption:
TXT have topped Korea's Circle weekly album chart with their 9th mini album 'PERFECT STORM'!

For the week of Nov 15–21, 'PERFECT STORM' sold 1,463,034 copies on the album chart, and 1,766,818 including Weverse and SMC versions. Title track 'Angel Bite' also took No. 1 on the download chart, giving TXT a double crown. Elsewhere, ATEEZ's 'GOLDEN HOUR : Part.6' led the retail album chart for a 2nd week, and BESTie's 2013 song 'Love Options' hit No. 1 on the Global K-pop chart after going viral on short-form video.

📌 Source: Circle Chart, via Korean media (News Culture, GP Korea)
